protocol.baseline: Frozen C7 d6, threshold112, actual Q4d PL download; A/C2/C5 unchanged
protocol.selection_annotation: Original training AH only; all 20 images have previously been inspected, no claim of fresh holdout
protocol.bright_protection: max(raw green in replicated17x17)>=192. No additions in protected region. Original Gaussian3 bright core+radius7 band is a subset, with no GT in protection. Baseline predictions preserved exactly.
protocol.fov_protection: No new pixels within8 pixels of original FOV boundary; baseline C7 pixels preserved
protocol.weak_support: Frozen C7 bilateral5 distance1 or2 minimum>=margin and matching central support>=0; score>=max(1,T-offset), optionally OR existing C5 final mask at fixedT28
protocol.connectivity: Four or eight fixed synchronous 8-neighbor reconstruction stages, every new pixel requires weak_support and protection clearance. No arbitrary endpoints/straight-line bridging, no CPU/PS repair
protocol.selection: Only eligible candidates, highest sum macro Dice+clDice across sizes, tie fewer stages then fewer optional paths. Freeze choice before re-evaluation of old heldout/VK. If none pass preserve failures and investigate next predeclared family, do not weaken bright invariant.
protocol.post_selection_gates: All40 cases xAH/VK: bright core/band pixel identity and baseline-mask superset; each image nondecreasing Dice, thin/centerline recall and adjacent-edge coverage; each size/split/observer mean clDice nondecreasing; im0324/512 both observers thin and centerline recall strictly improve. Any failure rejects the candidate for next board release, no post-evaluation retune.
protocol.resource_preflight: Reuse C7 features/window and model, C5 and standard DMA/DDR. Extra protect max17 plus <=8 serial3x3 16/32bit window stages; within140BRAM only after actual implementation. RQ81 new identity; retain prior modes and original bytes. No resource/timing PASS from estimates.
